premium.howBody:
1) Hlawula isixa saNyanga le. 
2) Faka i-UPI / ireferensi yentengiselwano yebhanki. 
3) Thumela isicelo - ivula i-imeyile kwinkxaso yethu yeGmail. 
4) Umlawuli uqinisekisa intlawulo kwaye uvule iPremium kwiakhawunti yakho.

settings.restoreWarnBody:
Ngenisa uhlaziyo lwentengiselwano kunye nohlahlo lwabiwo-mali kuphela kuluhlu lomhla kwifayile. Idatha engaphandle koluhlu kule fowuni ihlala. 

Iiakhawunti: zibuyiselwa kwifayile kuphela ukuba le fowuni ayinazo zezentengiselwano okwangoku (umzekelo emva kokufakwa kwakhona). Kungenjalo iiakhawunti zakho zangoku zihlala. 

Uya kubuzwa ukuba uthathe indawo yezikhumbuzo kunye noluhlu lokuthenga. 

Ukuba ungqamaniso lwamafu ePrimiyamu luvuliwe, iziphumo ezidityanisiweyo ziyangqinelaniswa (eyokugqibela ~ iminyaka emi-2 efini).

import.lead: Skena ibhanki okanye uodole imiyalezo, coma umbhalo, okanye uqhoboshele umfanekiso weskrini. Phonononga iimidlalo phambi kokugcina - akukho nto yongezwa ngokuzenzekelayo.

import.smsHintAuto: Iskena iSMS yenyanga ekhethiweyo yekhalenda ye-UPI / iikhredithi zebhanki kunye nedebhithi. Akukho nto igcinwayo de uqinisekise ngezantsi.

import.smsIos: Usetyenziso lwe-iOS alukwazi ukufunda iSMS. Ukungeniswa ngaphandle kwe-Android kuphela.
import.smsNeedBuild: Olu lwakhiwo lwe-app olufakelweyo alukwazi ukufunda i-SMS okwangoku.
import.smsNeedBuildDetail: I-APK yakho yangoku yakhiwa phambi kokuba ufundo lweSMS longezwe. I-Expo Go nayo ayikwazi ukufunda iSMS. I-app kufuneka yakhiwe kwakhona kwaye iphinde ifakwe ukuze ikwazi ukuvula i-inbox kwaye yenze utshintshiselwano ukusuka kwimiyalezo yekhredithi / yedebit.
import.smsNeedBuildAction: Cela ulwakhiwo olutsha lophuhliso lwe-Android, faka i-APK, emva koko uvule ukungenisa kwakhona - iya kuskena iSMS ngokuzenzekelayo.
import.smsDenied: I-Pulse Wallet ayikwazanga ukufunda ibhokisi yakho yangaphakathi. Vula Useto → Iimvume → SMS kwaye uyivumele, emva koko ucofe Funda iSMS kwakhona. Ukuba iSMS ayidweliswanga apho, le APK yakhiwe ngaphandle kwemvume yeSMS kwaye idinga ukwakhiwa kwakhona.

terms.guide3Body:
La macandelo angezantsi ahamba kuwo onke amanqaku ngendlela onokuthi uhlangabezane nayo, ukusuka kwisikrini saseKhaya ukuya kwiakhawunti yakho kunye nedatha. Nganye ichaza into eyenziwa licandelo kunye nendlela eliziphatha ngayo, ukuze wazi into ovuma ukuyisebenzisa.

Ezinye iifitsha zinokucinywa, kuxatyiswe ngokwahlukileyo, okanye zikhutshwe kancinci kancinci ngumshicileli, ngoko ke into oyibonayo kwi-App isoloko iligama lokugqibela. Amaxabiso kunye namaxabiso anikwe apha ayimiyo kwaye angatshintsha.
terms.guide31Body:
Ibhendi ephezulu yeKhaya ibonisa iiNdleko, uMvuzo kunye neNgxowa-mali yenyanga yangoku yekhalenda. Ukucofa Iindleko okanye uMvuzo kuvula uluhlu oluhambelanayo.

Xa unekhadi letyala, umzobo ngamnye wahlulwe ube yimiqolo emibini. Umqolo weBhanki yimali ehamba ngee-akhawunti ezigcina imali yokwenyani, equka ibhili yekhadi oyihlawuleyo. Umqolo we-Cr.Card ufunda ikhadi ngokuchasene nomda walo endaweni yoko, ubonisa ukuba ungakanani umda owusebenzisileyo, umda ngokwawo, kunye nento eseleyo. Le miqolo mibini idibanisa yonke into oyichithileyo.

Ungayifihla ibhendi yesishwankathelo, ukhethe ukuba iKhaya liyavula kwiiNdleko okanye uMvuzo, kwaye usete indlela intengiselwano ihlelwa ngayo, kwiiSetingi ze-App phantsi kwekhasi laseKhaya.
terms.guide32Body:
Iqhosha elingu-+ livula ifomu yokongeza. Khetha iNcitho, uMvuzo okanye ikhadi leTyala, khetha udidi, emva koko ufake imali, i-akhawunti ephuma kuyo okanye eyile kuyo, umhla, kunye nenqaku lokuzikhethela.

Ungaqhoboshela ifoto yetyala kwintengiselwano. Ungeniso lwegrosari lunokwahlulwa lube yinto nganye enemihla yokuphelelwa kwayo, nto leyo enokukunyusela izikhumbuzo zegrosari ngokuzenzekelayo.

Nayiphi na intengiselwano inokuhlelwa okanye icinywe kamva ngokuyicofa kuluhlu.
terms.guide33Body:
Ikhadi letyala aliyiyo imbiza yemali, ngoko i-App iyilandelela ngokuchasene nomda wayo. Sebenzisa "umda wekhadi letyala" ukurekhoda umda owunikwe yibhanki yakho; oku kugcinwa njengemali yokuqala yekhadi kwaye ayibalwa njengengeniso.

Into oyichithayo ekhadini yinkcitho enciphisa umda okhoyo. "Ityala letyala letyala" libhala ukuhlawula ikhadi njengokudluliselwa kwi-akhawunti ehlawule kwikhadi. Oko kubuyisela umda okhoyo kwaye kubalwa njengemali ephuma kwi-akhawunti yokuhlawula, ngelixa umntu echitha ukuhlala ebalwa ngokuchasene nekhadi, ngoko ke imali efanayo ayibalwa kabini.

Umda awusetwanga kwakhona ekupheleni kwenyanga. Inkcitho engahlawulwanga igcina umda okhoyo uncitshisiwe logama nje ungahlawulwanga, kwaye ukuhlawula ityala kuko okubuyisela umda.
terms.guide34Body:
Iiakhawunti kulapho imali yakho ihlala khona. Kukho iindidi ezimbini: i-akhawunti yemali, eboniswa njengeBhanki / Ikhadi leMali / iKhadi lokutsalwa, kunye neKhadi leTyala. Unokongeza ezinye iiakhawunti, uzinike ngokutsha, uzinike i-icon, okanye ufihle enye ongasayisebenzisiyo.

Kwi-akhawunti yemali, i-App ibonisa into ebikhona ukuya kuthi ga ekupheleni kwenyanga ephelileyo, umvuzo kunye neendleko zale nyanga, kunye nentsalela efunyenweyo. Kwikhadi lokuthenga ngetyala libonisa umlinganiselo wetyala lilonke, ungakanani na osetyenziswayo, kwaye yintoni ekhoyo.

Ibhalansi ibalwa ukusuka kwibhalansi yakho yokuqala kunye nayo yonke into oyirekhodileyo ukusukela oko. I-App ayikhe iqhagamshelane nebhanki yakho ukubajonga.
terms.guide35Body:
Isikrini seTransaction sidwelisa umvuzo wakho okanye iindleko zosuku olukhethiweyo, inyanga okanye unyaka. Umqolo weetshiphusi ikuvumela ukuba ucuthe uluhlu kwiakhawunti enye, kwaye itotali yaloo mbono ihluziweyo iboniswe ecaleni.

Isishwankathelo esisezipilini eziphezulu zeKhaya: Iindleko, uMvuzo kunye neMali eseleyo kwiakhawunti yakho yemali, kunye neendleko zekhadi letyala, umlinganiselo opheleleyo kunye nomda okhoyo kuluhlu lwazo olungaphantsi.

Useto lwe-App lukwabonelela ngokujonga zonke iintengiselwano, apho unokuhluza khona ixesha, khetha imigca emininzi ngaxeshanye, kwaye uyicime kunye.
terms.guide36Body:
Kwi-Android i-App inokufunda imiyalezo yebhanki esele ikwi-inbox yakho kwaye iyiguqule ibe yidrafti yentengiselwano. Icela imvume yeSMS kuqala, kwaye unokwala. Imiyalezo ifundwa kwisixhobo sakho kwaye ayilayishwa naphi na.

Ijonga ifestile yamva nje yemiyalezo, isebenze isixa-mali, umhla, umrhwebi, nokuba ibiyimali ngaphakathi okanye ngaphandle, kwaye yeyiphi iakhawunti okanye ikhadi elisetyenzisiweyo, emva koko iqikelela udidi olusuka kwigama lomrhwebi. Imiyalezo engeyiyo intengiselwano, efana namagama ayimfihlo exesha elinye, iintlawulo ezingaphumeleliyo, iziteyitimenti, izaziso zomhla omiselweyo kunye nemali-mboleko okanye unikezelo lomlinganiselo wetyala, ziyahluzwa.

Akukho nto igcinwayo de uqinisekise. Ungakhetha okanye ucime yonke into, ucofe imiqolo eyahlukeneyo, kwaye utshintshe udidi phambi kokuthatha ngaphandle. Imiqolo osele uyingenisile iyakhunjulwa kwaye ayizukufakwa kabini.

Apho i-SMS ingafumanekiyo unokuncamathisela umbhalo womyalezo endaweni yoko. Amangeniso asuka kumazwe angaphandle achanekile kuphela njengemiyalezo asuka kuyo, kwaye unoxanduva lokuwajonga.
terms.guide37Body: Iintengiselwano zihlelwe ngokweendidi ezifana neZitya, Ukutya, ezoThutho, iRente, i-EMI, amatyala kunye noMvuzo. Unokongeza eyakho ngophawu olukhethiweyo kunye nombala, uyithiye ngokutsha okanye ucime ezo wongezileyo, kwaye ulusete ngokutsha uludwe lubuyele kokungagqibekanga. Udidi lweZinye alunakususwa, ngoko ke akukho nto isala ngaphandle kwekhaya.
terms.guide38Body: Unokumisela umda wenyanga kulo naliphi na icandelo leendleko kwaye ujonge oko ukuchithileyo ngokuchasene nalo, kuquka ukukhuphela imida yenyanga ephelileyo kweli. Uhlahlo lwabiwo-mali sisikhokelo sakho; iApp ayikuthinteli inkcitho okanye ikuyekise ukurekhoda intengiselwano ehamba ngaphezulu kwenye.
terms.guide39Body:
Iitshathi zibonisa apho imali yakho iye khona njengokwahlulwa kwecandelo, kunye neendlela zokuchitha kunye nothelekiso lwenyanga nenyanga. IKhalenda ibonisa usuku ngalunye lwenyanga kunye neetotali zalo, kwaye ucofe uluhlu lolo suku.

I-Smart Insights ifunda eyakho idatha erekhodiweyo kwisixhobo sakho kwaye yalatha izinto ezifana nohlahlo lwabiwo-mali okufutshane ukuba uluphumelele, udidi oluye lwatsiba xa luthelekiswa nenyanga ephelileyo, okanye inyanga kungekho ngeniso irekhodiweyo. Ulwazi luqwalaselo malunga nento oyifakileyo, hayi ingcebiso, kwaye luphawu lweNtlawulo.
terms.guide310Body: Incwadi yemali yisethi eyahlukileyo yee-akhawunti, ukuthengiselana kunye nohlahlo lwabiwo-mali, ngoko unako ukugcina, umzekelo, iirekhodi zekhaya kunye nezoshishino ngaphandle. Uqala ngenye ebizwa ngokuba yeyoBuntu, kwaye unokwenza ngakumbi, uyithiye ngokutsha, utshintshe i-icon yabo, ugcine ezo ugqibe ngazo, okanye uzicime. Yincwadi oyivulileyo kuphela eboniswa naphi na kwi-App.
terms.guide311Body:
Indawo yokusebenza yeZikhumbuzi ibandakanya amatyala aqhubekayo, amayeza anedosi yasekuseni, emva kwemini nangokuhlwa, igrosari esondela kumhla wokuphelelwa, kunye nezikhumbuzo eziqhelekileyo. Unokuseta ukuba ulumkisiwe kangakanani na, ixesha lokufika kwesilumkiso semihla ngemihla, kwaye i-alam ikhala ixesha elingakanani, kwaye unokuvavanya i-alam nangaliphi na ixesha.

Izikhumbuzo ziluncedo kuphela. Ukuba umntu uyafikelela kuwe kuxhomekeke kuseto lwesixhobo sakho, iimvume, imeko yebhetri kunye nemida yenkqubo yokusebenza, ngoko ke nceda ungathembeli kubo ngayo nayiphi na into ebalulekileyo.
terms.guide312Body:
Indawo yokusebenzela yokuThengisa igcina uluhlu olulula lwezinto ezinobungakanani onokuthi ukhangele kwaye uphawule njengoko uthenge.

Indawo yokusebenza ye-Slit ikuvumela ukuba wabelane ngeendleko nabahlobo kunye namaqela, wahlule isixa-mali ngokulinganayo, ngezixa kanye, ngepesenti, ngezabelo okanye ngohlengahlengiso, kwaye ugcine ingxelo yokuba ngubani otyala ntoni. Ifuna i-akhawunti ongene kuyo kwaye iluphawu lweNtlawulo. I-App igcina irekhodi kuphela; ayishukumisi imali phakathi kwakho nabani na.
terms.guide313Body: Ukukhangela kwiheda kujongwe kwiintengiselwano zakho, izikhumbuzo, izinto zokuthenga kunye nesetingi. Ungatshintsha imali ebonisiweyo kwi-header chip, etshintsha indlela amanani aboniswa ngayo kwaye ayiwaguquleli. IApp ifumaneka ngeelwimi ezininzi. Esi sikhokelo siguqulelwe kwakhona, ngelixa amacandelo asemthethweni eMiqathango yokuSebenzisa anikwe ngesiNgesi.
terms.guide314Body: Ungayitshintsha inkangeleko ye-App enemixholo kwaye unike iprofayile yakho i-avatar yomlinganiswa. Umxholo wasimahla uhlala ufumaneka, kwaye okuseleyo kunokuvulwa ngePremium okanye kuqeshwe ngedayimane.
terms.guide315Body:
Iidayimani ngumvuzo ongaphakathi kwi-app ongenaxabiso lemali. Azinakuthengwa, zithengiswe, zitshintshelwe okanye zitshintshwe ngemali, kwaye azibuyiswa.

Uzizuza ngokukhetha ukubukela intengiso enemivuzo kude kube sekupheleni, nangokumema abahlobo. Kukho umda wokuba zingaphi onokuzifumana kwiintengiso ngosuku ngalunye. Ibhalansi yakho kunye nomda wemihla ngemihla ubanjiwe kwaye ujongiwe kwiseva yethu usebenzisa ixesha leseva, ke ukutshintsha iwotshi yesixhobo sakho akuyi kukwandisa oko unokukufumana.

Ungachitha iidayimani kwiPrimiyamu yokupasa ethatha inani elithile leentsuku, okanye kwizinto ezongezelelweyo ezifana ne-avatar, umxholo, okanye i-Smart Insights okwethutyana. Ukudlula okanye ukuvula okuthengwe ngedayimani kukunika uphawu lwexesha elixeliweyo kuphela, emva koko luphele. Amaxabiso, umvuzo wentengiso nganye kunye nomda wemihla ngemihla ubonisiwe kwi-App kwaye unokutshintsha nangaliphi na ixesha.

Ukupasa kwePremium efunyenwe ngedayimani kuvula iimpawu kodwa ayisusi iintengiso. Kuphela iNtlawulo yaNyanga le ihlawulwayo engenazibhengezo.
terms.guide316Body:
Iakhawunti nganye ongene kuyo ifumana ikhowudi yesimemo. Ukuba umhlobo ufaka ikhowudi yakho, nobabini nifumana iidayimani, ngokuxhomekeke kumda wokuba zingaphi izimemo ezivuzwayo.

Ikhowudi inokusetyenziswa kube kanye umntu ngamnye, awukwazi ukusebenzisa eyakho, kwaye sinokubamba imbuyekezo apho sikholelwa ukuba iikhowudi ziyaxhatshazwa, umzekelo ngeakhawunti ephindwe kabini okanye ezenzekelayo.
terms.guide317Body:
Ukusetyenziswa simahla kugcina iirekhodi zakho kwisixhobo sakho, kubonisa iintengiso, kwaye kushiye ezinye iimpawu zitshixiwe. Kwaye kuvula izinto ozikhethayo, kwaye iPremium ivula yonke into, isuse iintengiso, kwaye yenza ungqamaniso lwamafu.

Intlawulo yenziwa ngesandla yi-UPI, emva koko usithumelele ireferensi yentlawulo kwaye sivula iakhawunti yakho. Ukuqalisa akuko ngoko nangoko. Amaxabiso, imixholo yesicwangciso kunye namaxesha okuhlawula abonisiwe kwi-App kwaye anokutshintsha; utshintsho aluchaphazeli ixesha osele ulihlawulele.
terms.guide318Body:
Abasebenzisi basimahla banokubona ibhena kunye neentengiso zemveli kwiindawo ze-App, kwaye banokukhetha ukubukela iintengiso zevidiyo ezivuzayo ukuze bafumane idayimani. Ukubukela intengiso enemivuzo kusoloko kukhetho lwakho kwaye akufuneki ukuba usebenzise uphawu osele unalo.

Iintengiso zinikezelwa liqela lesithathu kwaye zixhomekeke kwimigaqo yazo kunye nemigaqo-nkqubo yabucala. Intlawulo yaNyanga le iyawasusa.
terms.guide319Body:
NgePremium kunye neakhawunti esayiniweyo, iincwadi zakho ezinkozo, intengiselwano, uhlahlo lwabiwo-mali, izikhumbuzo, iindidi kunye nemifanekiso yebhili encanyathiselweyo inokuvumelanisa ukuze ukwazi ukuthatha kwesinye isixhobo. Ungqamaniso lufuna uqhagamshelo olusebenzayo kwaye lunokulibaziseka okanye lungaphelelanga, ngoko ke nceda ungayithathi njengekopi yakho kuphela.

Ugcino lwamafu ngokuqhelekileyo lugcina malunga neminyaka emibini yokugqibela yeerekhodi zomhla. Amangeno amadala ahlala kwisixhobo esiwadalileyo.

Ungangena kuphela kwisixhobo esinye ngexesha; ukungena kwenye indawo kuphelisa iseshoni yangaphambili.
terms.guide320: 3.20 Gcina, ukuthumela ngaphandle kunye nokucima idatha yakho
terms.guide320Body:
IPremium ikuvumela ukuba ugcine ifayile egciniweyo yedatha yakho kwaye uyibuyisele kamva. Ukubuyisela kwakhona kuthatha indawo yento ekhoyo ngoku kwisixhobo, kwaye ukujonga ifayile luxanduva lwakho. Ungakwazi nokuthumela ngaphandle intengiselwano yakho njenge-spreadsheet kuluhlu lomhla olukhethileyo.

Ungayicima idatha yakho nangaliphi na ixesha: ukusuka kwesi sixhobo, kwilifu, okanye zombini. Ukucinywa kusisigxina, ke thatha i-backup kuqala ukuba unokufuna iirekhodi kwakhona.
terms.guide321Body: Ungajonga ngapha nangapha uninzi lweApp ngaphandle kweakhawunti. Ukugcina iirekhodi zakho, ukuthumela imiyalezo ngaphandle, ukufumana okanye ukuchitha iidayimani, kunye nokuvumelanisa zonke zifuna ukuba ungene ngemvume, ongayenza ngeGoogle, iApple okanye idilesi ye-imeyile kunye negama lokugqitha.
